arxiv-2011-03281.title: Corpora Compared: The Case of the Swedish Gigaword & Wikipedia Corpora
arxiv-2011-03281.creator: Tosin P. Adewumi, Foteini Liwicki, Marcus Liwicki
arxiv-2011-03281.description: Abstract In this work, we show that the difference in performance of embeddings from differently sourced data for a given language can be due to other factors besides data size. Natural language processing (NLP) tasks usually perform better with embeddings from bigger corpora. However, broadness of covered domain and noise can play important roles.

arxiv-2111-14723.title: Quantum fluctuations, particles and entanglement: a discussion towards the solution of the quantum measurement problems Dedicated to the memory of Giampiero Paffuti.
arxiv-2111-14723.creator: Kenichi Konishi, [13pt] INFN, Sezione di Pisa, Largo Pontecorvo, 3, Ed. C, 56127 Pisa, Italy, [2pt] Department of Physics “E. Fermi”, University of Pisa, [-5pt] Largo Pontecorvo, 3, Ed. C, 56127 Pisa, Italy [2pt][1pt] kenichi.konishi@unipi.it
arxiv-2111-14723.description: Abstract The quantum measurement problems are revisited from a new perspective. One of the main ideas of this work is that the basic entities of our world are various types of particles, elementary or composite. It follows that each elementary process, hence each measurement process at its core, is a spacetime, pointlike, event.

arxiv-2211-05313.title: Ion optical clocks with three electronic states
arxiv-2211-05313.creator: C. A. Holliman, M. Fan, A. M. Jayich
arxiv-2211-05313.description: Abstract Optical clocks are the apotheosis of precision measurement, but they require frequent maintenance by scientists. The supporting laser systems are a particularly demanding component of these instruments. To reduce complexity and increase robustness we propose an optical clock with trapped alkali-like ions that use the S 1 / 2 → D 3 / 2 S_{1/2}\rightarrow D_{3/2} electric quadrupole transition.

arxiv-2308-11603.title: Separability in Morse local-to-global groups
arxiv-2308-11603.creator: Lawk Mineh and Davide Spriano
arxiv-2308-11603.description: Abstract . We show that in a Morse local-to-global group where stable subgroups are separable, the product of any stable subgroups is separable. As an application, we show that the product of stable subgroups in virtually special groups is separable. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 20F67; 20E26 1.

arxiv-2312-01575.title: A Challenging Multimodal Video Summary: Simultaneously Extracting and Generating Keyframe-Caption Pairs from Video
arxiv-2312-01575.creator: Keito Kudo Haruki Nagasawa Jun Suzuki Nobuyuki Shimizu
arxiv-2312-01575.description: Abstract This paper proposes a practical multimodal video summarization task setting and a dataset to train and evaluate the task. The target task involves summarizing a given video into a predefined number of keyframe-caption pairs and displaying them in a listable format to grasp the video content quickly.

arxiv-2411-08903.title: Turkey’s Earthquakes: Damage Prediction and Feature Significance Using A Multivariate Analysis
arxiv-2411-08903.creator: Shrey Shah Alex Lin Scott Lin Josh Patel
arxiv-2411-08903.description: Abstract Accurate damage prediction is crucial for disaster preparedness and response strategies, particularly given the frequent earthquakes in Turkey. Utilizing datasets on earthquake data, infrastructural quality metrics, and contemporary socioeconomic factors, we tested various machine-learning architectures to forecast death tolls and fatalities per affected population. Our findings indicate that the Random Forest model provides the most reliable predictions.

arxiv-2502-18266.title: Parsing TTree Formula in Python
arxiv-2502-18266.creator: \firstname Aryan \lastname Roy, \firstname Jim \lastname Pivarski \fnsep
arxiv-2502-18266.description: Abstract Uproot can read ROOT files directly in pure Python but cannot (yet) compute expressions in ROOT’s TTreeFormula expression language. Despite its popularity, this language has only one implementation and no formal specification. In a package called “formulate,” we defined the language’s syntax in standard BNF and parse it with Lark, a fast and modern parsing toolkit in Python.

pmc-10554590.title: FRI176 Integrated Profiling Analysis Of Serum Steroids And Catecholamines In A Single Run With LC-MS
pmc-10554590.creator: Jongsung Noh, Chaelin Lee, Seung Shin Park, Chang Ho Ahn, Seung-Woon Myung, Jung Hee Kim, Man Ho Choi
pmc-10554590.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Choi: None.Adrenal steroids and catecholamines are associated with the response against biochemical stress and adrenal disorders. Metabolic alteration of these hormones could be quantitatively evaluated in diagnostic process, but both adrenal cortex and medullary hormones have been measured in different analytical platforms. To increase the bio-analytical validity, liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) based simultaneous profiling of 29 steroids and 6 catecholamines was developed. After alkyloxycarbonylation with isobutyl chloroformate, catecholamines and steroids were extracted simultaneously in liquid-liquid extraction.

pmc-10641225.title: On soft parametric somewhat-open sets and applications via soft topologies
pmc-10641225.creator: Tareq M Al-shami, Abdelwaheb Mhemdi
pmc-10641225.description: In this work, we adopt a new approach to study a new class of soft sets depending on the generalizations of open subsets in the parametric topological spaces. We first define the class of soft parametric somewhat-open sets and explore its basic features.

pmc-11432093.title: Advances in the Insulin–Heart Axis: Current Therapies and Future Directions
pmc-11432093.creator: Alfredo Caturano, Erica Vetrano, Raffaele Galiero, Celestino Sardu, Luca Rinaldi, Vincenzo Russo, Marcellino Monda, Raffaele Marfella, Ferdinando Carlo Sasso
pmc-11432093.description: The insulin–heart axis plays a pivotal role in the pathophysiology of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in insulin-resistant states, including type 2 diabetes mellitus. Insulin resistance disrupts glucose and lipid metabolism, leading to systemic inflammation, oxidative stress, and atherogenesis, which contribute to heart failure (HF) and other CVDs.

pmc-11712191.title: Applying the eHealth Literacy lens to evaluate a virtual assistant to support family carers of people with dementia
pmc-11712191.creator: Tuan Anh Nguyen
pmc-11712191.description: BackgroundWe have co‐produced with carers of people with dementia (hereafter carers) a culturally tailored iSupport Virtual Assistant (VA), namely e‐DiVA, to support English‐, Bahasa‐ and Vietnamese‐speaking carers in Australia, Indonesia, New Zealand and Vietnam. The presented research reports qualitative findings from the e‐DiVA user‐testing study.

pmc-13038800.title: Mechanoreceptor-mediated adaptations to physical exercise: from acute responses to long-term training effects
pmc-13038800.creator: Emilie Maufroy, Nicolas Baeyens, Gael Deboeck
pmc-13038800.description: Acute exercise induces a marked increase in blood flow to active muscles, elevating mechanical forces on the vascular wall, most notably fluid shear stress and circumferential stretch. These stimuli are sensed by endothelial and vascular smooth muscle cells, triggering intracellular signaling cascades that, over time, drive vascular remodeling and long-term functional adaptation.

pmc-13278767.title: Use of the dual tyrosine kinase inhibitor lapatinib for the treatment of vulvovaginal squamous cell carcinoma in a dog
pmc-13278767.creator: Mark J Vardanega, Tiffany Longo, Alex Aceino, Caleb K Alexander
pmc-13278767.description: Vulvovaginal squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) is an uncommon neoplasm in dogs. An 11-year-old female spayed German Shepherd dog presented with a history of excessive peri-vulvar grooming and a 3 cm × 3 cm irregular mass involving the vagina and vulva. Incisional biopsy confirmed a diagnosis of primary vulvovaginal SCC.

pmc-13548343.title: Invertebrates at the Land‐Sea Interface in a Climate Change World: Heatwaves, Floods, Fire and Ice
pmc-13548343.creator: Maria Byrne, Pauline M Ross
pmc-13548343.description: With their location at the land‐sea edge, coastal marine invertebrates withstand marked changes in water and air temperatures and abrupt salinity changes through tidal cycles. In a climate‐changing world, these stressors are being magnified by the increased intensity and emergence of extreme climatic events (ECEs).

pmc-13669325.title: Revisiting the cognitive potential of lithium in alzheimer’s disease: the role of cholinergic system and brain connectivity
pmc-13669325.creator: Lorenzo Pini, Bruno Pietro Imbimbo, Nunzio Pomara
pmc-13669325.description: Recent evidence demonstrating a marked reduction in endogenous brain lithium levels in mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) has renewed interest in lithium as a physiological modulator of brain aging and neurodegeneration. Experimental data indicate that lithium deficiency accelerates amyloid-β deposition, tau pathology, synaptic and myelin loss, whereas physiological lithium replacement mitigates neuropathology and cognitive decline.
